grammar.title: At the same time with 同时
grammar.explanation: 同时 (tóngshí) means "at the same time" it shows two things happening together, or adds a second point that applies at once. It can start a sentence or sit right before the verb.

grammar.title: Mistaken assumptions with 以为
grammar.explanation: 以为 (yǐwéi) means "thought (wrongly) that...". Unlike 觉得 or 认为, 以为 usually signals that what you believed turned out not to be true.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bù lái le.
Wǒmen dōu yǐwéi tā shì lǎoshī.
sentences.en: We all thought she was a teacher.
I thought this method would work.

sentences.pinyin: Tā tóngshí zuò liǎng jiàn shì.
sentences.en: He does two things at the same time.
We arrived at the same time.

sentences.zh: 这个方法同时也很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ tóngshí yě hěn ānquán.
sentences.en: This method is also safe at the same time.

sentences.zh: 她同时在两个公司工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóngshí zài liǎng gè gōngsī gōngzuò.
sentences.en: She works at two companies at the same time.
The rain got heavier and heavier.
